newsitem.title: USA: Four Corners 750 MW coal-fired unit still down.
newsitem.headline: Four Corners 750 MW coal-fired unit still down.

text.p: The 750 megawatt (MW) unit 5 at the Four Corners coal-fired power plant in New Mexico remains out of service, but is tentatively scheduled to restart at 2000 MST on Thursday, sources familiar with the plant's operations said early Thursday.
The unit was shut early Tuesday morning for tube leak repairs.
Arizona Public Service Co operates Four Corners and owns units 1, 2 and 3 along with 15 percent of units 4 and 5.
Southern California Edison Co holds a 48 percent stake in units 4 and 5.
